name: visual_prompt_tool
description: Overlay a visual prompt (plain grid, labeled coordinate grid, or bone-focused mesh) on a medical X-ray so a multimodal LLM has explicit spatial scaffolding for reasoning and localization.

help.summary: Overlay a visual prompt on the active X-ray image (grid / labeled grid / bone mesh).
options: grid_n=<int> grid cells per side (grid modes, default 8)
mesh_spacing=<int> mesh line spacing in px (bone_mesh, default 22)
